summary: Adds 436 Hugo `aliases:` front-matter entries so legacy DocBook-era /documentation/head/*.html and /documentation/NN/*.html URLs redirect to the consolidated Hugo pages.

tests.evidence: Docs front-matter only; no code behavior to test (the description reports a hugo build and link check).

user_docs.evidence: The whole change is to the user-facing docs site: each legacy slug must map to the page that now holds its content (e.g. arrays/replication/parameterstatus.html -> server-prepare, java8-date-time.html -> query); no reviewer comments and the diff was merged unchanged.

change_description.evidence: Description gives why, what, verification steps and Fixes #2608; docs-site fix needs no driver changelog entry.

performance.evidence: Static redirect stubs; no runtime path.

security.evidence: Meta-refresh aliases to fixed internal paths; no untrusted input or open redirect.

backward_compat.evidence: Restores previously indexed URLs; only adds aliases, existing six aliases kept (e.g. head/ds-ds.html, head/connect.html).

correctness.evidence: Mapping table is data rather than logic; base tree has no static/documentation files that would collide with the alias stubs, and the author reports no duplicate alias paths.

user_value.evidence: Fixes 404s for indexed links; value is obvious and was agreed in #2608.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Redirects to topical equivalents are the expected behavior.

contradictions.evidence: No prose changed alongside the aliases.

build_ci.evidence: Increases Hugo alias output (Aliases | 437); no build config changed.

plan.why: Docs-only data change; one reviewer checks the slug-to-page mapping.
